newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Bankers' Assoc told keep 26.40 peso.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Bankers' Assoc told keep 26.40 peso.

text.p: The Philippine Bankers Association (BAP), invoking rules not used in two years, said on Friday it would not include today's sharply lower traded peso rates when calculating the day's weighted average for the resumption of trading next Monday.
It said it will use 26.40 pesos to the dollar as the average traded rate for Friday when trading resumes on Monday.
The peso slumped 11.50 percent to 29.45 pesos in morning trading but as these rates went outside the 1-1/2 percent band allowed by the BAP, and though valid will not be used in the average.
